name: What to Do Immediately After a Fire Strikes Your Home

step.name: Step 1
step.text: It's tough when a fire hits, and knowing what to do next can feel overwhelming. Your first priority, once everyone is safe, is always to contact your insurance agent to file a claim. They'll guide you on the next steps for coverage. After that, it's crucial to connect with a reputable restoration company like First To Respond Restoration. They'll perform an initial assessment to determine the full extent of the fire and smoke damage, which often goes beyond what's visible. You'll want a detailed estimate, along with their license and insurance info, before starting any work. Remember, fire and smoke damage can be tricky, impacting structural integrity, leaving corrosive ash, and causing lingering odors. Trying to tackle it yourself can sometimes make things worse or even put your health at risk. For complex fire damage situations in the San Fernando Valley and surrounding areas, a professional team can ensure a thorough and safe restoration process. Don't hesitate to reach out for expert help when you're facing such a challenging situation.
